# Opsburg

> Opsburg is a steampunk city builder for DevOps, SRE and platform engineers. Every building in your flying city is a real piece of infrastructure, every airship is a real deploy, and every storm is a real incident.

- Clocktower: control plane
- Boiler House: compute node
- Factory: service
- Vault: database
- Telegraph: message queue
- Observatory: monitoring
- Lightning Spire: firewall
- Airship: deploy
- Storm: incident; pressure: load; coal: cost

Status: in development, not playable yet.

- Home: https://opsburg.github.io/
